name: Antipathy, Hasty
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level druid 9, occultist 6, psychic 8, summoner 6, witch 8, wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one location (up to a 10-ft. cube)
Duration 3 rounds
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as antipathy except as noted above and as follows. It only functions on an area, not an object. It does not counter or dispel sympathy.
